job.text: Make the call-centre managers aware of which centres fall short of the satisfaction target

insight.important: South and East fell short of the target of 7 out of 10

title.text: South and East Fell Short of the Satisfaction Target
title.descriptive: Average Caller Satisfaction Rating by Call Centre, January 2020

source.shows: the book's call-centre table redrawn as a dot plot (the ratings' zero is arbitrary, D-30): the target as a dotted line, labelled at its end, and each centre good or bad by it, in red and green (G4.16, G8.13, D-18)
the same chart for black and white (audience.bw_risk): a bad dot filled and a good one open, so that the centres short of the target stand out without colour (D-18)
